question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

The spirit of the room was very __gloomy__ in his absence.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cheerful**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gloomy **means dark, dim, or depressing; filled with sadness or despair. (विषादपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: *The gloomy weather matched his mood after hearing the bad news.*
